title: Decoding a word into words
statement: For a Boolean word $w$, repeatedly split the current word into its first and second components, append the first component to the output, and continue with the second component; stop when the current word is empty. The output is the resulting list of Boolean words.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the component-splitting operations, so their precise behavior cannot be specified.
